square_base.note: Square footprint derives from grip outer dimensions, ensures stable mounting on tiles

hole_2_large.description: Large mounting hole with countersunk chamfered lip - alternative/secondary mounting

grip_geometry.description: Shelled cylindrical grip with 3mm walls, created via mirroring and shelling
construction_method: 2. Define wall boundaries at (radius + 3mm) from edge
3. Extrude half-section upward to full handle_height
4. Mirror across vertical axis through center to create full grip
5. Shell operation: 3mm walls on front, sides, and top
6. Creates 4-section hollow grip (front open, 3 walls remain)
grip_geometry.tilt_angle: 25 degrees backward away from open front
grip_geometry.tilt_direction: Away from open front section (backward lean)

base_profile.holes: Two circles at center: Ø4.5mm and Ø7.5mm (concentric or offset per design)

grip_profile.description: 2D profile section for cylindrical handle with slope

step1_grip_sketch.profile: Circular sketch (radius = handle_diameter/2) with wall boundaries at (radius+3mm)
step1_grip_sketch.result: 2D profile for grip walls and cavity

step3_mirror_full_grip.mirror_axis: Vertical line through handle_diameter circle center

step4_shell_grip.front_wall_removal: Remove front wall completely (creates open front)
step4_shell_grip.result: Hollow grip with 3 walls: 2 sides + 1 top, open front face

step5_extrude_base.profile: Square base face (derived from grip outer footprint)
step5_extrude_base.distance: handle_height (parameter used as base extrusion distance)

union.description: Unite base and grip sections into single solid
union.result: Single unified solid with base and grip

primary_parameter_flow: Input: handle_diameter (26mm default) - PRIMARY DRIVING PARAMETER
Input: handle_height (33mm default) - SECONDARY SCALING PARAMETER
Calculate: handle_radius = handle_diameter / 2 (13mm)
Calculate: outer_wall_radius = handle_radius + 3.0mm (16mm for grip walls)
Calculate: grip_midpoint = [handle_diameter/2, handle_diameter/2] (13, 13)
Hardcoded: slope_angle = 25 degrees (backward tilt from open front)
Hardcoded: wall_thickness = 3.0mm (shelled grip walls)
Hardcoded: grip_edge_offset = 3.0mm (distance from diameter circle to inner wall)
Hardcoded: small_hole_diameter = 4.5mm (through-all mounting hole)
Hardcoded: large_hole_diameter = 7.5mm (countersunk mounting hole)
Hardcoded: large_hole_offset = 4.5mm (upward extrusion creating countersink)
Hardcoded: chamfer_radius = 1.3mm (all edges including large hole lip)
Create circular sketch centered on handle_diameter midpoint
Create half-grip profile with wall boundaries
Extrude half-grip upward with 25° backward tilt to handle_height
Mirror half-grip across vertical axis to create complete grip
Shell grip: remove front wall, keep 3mm walls on sides and top
Extrude square base downward from grip footprint by handle_height distance
Create 4.5mm through-hole (bottom to top)
Create 7.5mm countersunk hole (through top with 4.5mm offset, 1.3mm chamfer)
Union/combine all bodies into single solid
Final model: Grip + Base + Mounting holes

geometry_notes.scaling_behavior: Handle scales proportionally with handle_diameter parameter
geometry_notes.height_behavior: Handle height independent of diameter - allows custom proportions
geometry_notes.slope_invariant: 25° slope angle remains constant regardless of parameter changes
geometry_notes.hole_invariant: Hole diameters (4.5mm, 7.5mm) remain constant regardless of parameter changes
geometry_notes.base_proportions: Square base always equals handle diameter - ensures stable mounting
geometry_notes.hole_positioning: Both holes centered on square base for symmetrical mounting
